PUNJAB PRIVATIZATION BOARD MINSTERIAL
PUNJAB PRIVATIZATION BOARD MINSTERIAL
SERVICE REGULATIONS, 2012
[Gazette of Punjab, Part III,
23rd January, 2013]
No.
SOG/PPB/5-168/2012, dated 28-4-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 43 of the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010, the Punjab
Privatization Board hereby makes the following Regulations namely:--
(1) These
Regulations may be called the Punjab Privatization Board Ministerial Service
Regulations, 2012.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
(3) The
method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limits and other matters
relates thereto for the posts shall be as given in the schedule annexed.
